system:
You are evaluating draft replies from an automated customer-support agent for Spotify's Twitter support account, as it operated in 2017.

Score the CANDIDATE REPLY on five criteria, each an integer 1-5.

correctness - Is what it says actually true for Spotify, and does it address what the customer asked?
  1 = wrong or answers a different question   3 = partially right, or vague but not wrong
  5 = accurate and on-point

groundedness - Is every claim supported by the PRECEDENTS shown?
  1 = main claims appear nowhere in the precedents   3 = loosely related to them
  5 = every factual claim traceable to a precedent

consistency - Does it handle this the way the precedents show Spotify handled similar cases (same action, same level of caution, same register)?
  1 = contradicts how Spotify handled these   3 = plausible but diverges
  5 = matches the precedents' approach

helpfulness - Does it move the customer forward?
  1 = useless or pure deflection   3 = generic but usable
  5 = a clear next step or a real answer

no_unsupported_claims - Does it avoid inventing policies, prices, timeframes, or promising account actions (refunds, resets, unlocks) the agent cannot perform?
  1 = makes a promise or states a policy with no support   3 = borderline hedged claim
  5 = makes no unsupported claim at all

Judge only the reply in front of you. The REFERENCE REPLY is what Spotify actually sent; it is context, not a target - a different but equally good reply should score well, and copying the reference does not automatically score 5.

Return ONLY JSON:
{"correctness": n, "groundedness": n, "consistency": n, "helpfulness": n, "no_unsupported_claims": n, "rationale": "<one sentence>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
how do I switch to annual billing? The page I was sent today doesn't seem to have any buttons :/ <link>

PRECEDENTS:

     spotify replied: Hi there! We don't have any info on this right now, but we'll let the right team know it's something you'd like to see

[62424] past customer: The only reason I have not purchased premium is because of recurring billing. Is there any way around this?
     spotify replied: Hey there! Could you head over at <link> and see if that helps? For anything else, let us know

[155374] past customer: hey there! I purchased a year subscription as a gift to be delivered on 11/18 and the email never was received. Could I please have it resent?
     spotify replied: Hi there! Can you let us know your account's email address or username? A screenshot of the receipt will also be super helpful. We'll take a look

[1875974] past customer: like to change my billing date but due to be billed 2mro. Should I wait & pay before I cancel? Want to change to 26th of month
     spotify replied: Hi Elaine! You can change your billing date by following the steps here: <link> Hope this helps

[2309843] past customer: Hi how do I change my monthly subscription to a yearly one?
     spotify replied: Hey! Just select 'See more offers' on the Payments page. This should bring up the option to pay yearly. Hope that helps

CANDIDATE REPLY (score this):
Hi there! We don't have any info on this right now, but we'll let the right team know it's something you'd like to see

REFERENCE REPLY actually sent by Spotify (context only):
Hi Mike! Could you send us your account's username or email address via DM? We'll take a look backstage /LP <link>

Return the JSON scores.
text: {"correctness":1,"groundedness":3,"consistency":2,"helpfulness":1,"no_unsupported_claims":4,"rationale":"Although the wording is supported by one precedent about requesting annual billing, it fails to provide the available instruction to select “See more offers” on the Payments page and incorrectly says Spotify has no information."}
